# Pull Request

## Summary / خلاصه

What does this PR change and why?

## Type of change / نوع تغییر

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking)
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Docs / README
- [ ] Grammar / theme update
- [ ] Linter / hover / completion change

## Checklist / فهرست

- [ ] `extension.js` stays CommonJS (no ESM/TypeScript).
- [ ] JSON files (grammar, themes, docs) parse cleanly.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]`.
- [ ] If the language data changed, `data/kolang-docs.json` is in sync with
      [kolang-ide](https://github.com/faralidev/kolang-ide)/kolang-language.js.
- [ ] Tested in an Extension Development Host (`F5`).

## Related issues / مسائل مرتبط

Closes #
